author: The Infographics Show
description:
Some of the facts you grew up believing are completely wrong, and a few of them are still shaping how people think about health, animals, food, and even crime.

This episode breaks down more common myths that somehow survived for decades, from baby birds being abandoned after humans touch them to frogs calmly boiling alive, gum staying in your stomach for seven years, and spiders crawling into your mouth while you sleep.
We also look at more serious misconceptions, including myths about vaccines, depression, OCD, diabetes, cancer, MSG, body weight, and the famous McDonald’s hot coffee lawsuit.

Some are harmless misunderstandings, others can affect how people treat their bodies, pets, food, or each other.

The truth is usually stranger, simpler, and a lot more useful than the myth.
